blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 SINGAPORE–Junmilardo Ogayre bolstered Philippine boxing’s bid for glory in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Ogayre on Wednesday advanced to the round of 16 in the men’s 60-kilogram class at Nishio Gymnasium in Japan. The Davao City native edged Mongolia’s Lundaa Gantumur by split decision, 3-2. READ: SCHEDULE: Team Philippines at Asian Games 2026 boxing Ogayre’s victory was a much-needed boost for the country’s boxing contingent, which came into the Japan Games without its top gold medal bet in Eumir Marcial.
